AniBox 1.15.2 (24 Nov 2026): one fix found by the tests on Windows.
- Internet Archive downloads: a download that archive.org answered with "busy" could stay "waiting" for ever on Windows instead of trying again. It now tries again on time.
Also in it, if you're coming from 1.15.0: the Shield's address and your languages in the phone app's sync folder, and "Copy as text" next to the QR code (1.15.1).
